# Fitaval

> Fitaval is a fitness community platform based in Kochi, Kerala, India. It helps people discover nearby gyms, connect with a supportive community, and track their growth. Tagline: "Discover Fitness. Connect with Community."

Fitaval brings gyms, trainers, gym owners and fitness enthusiasts together. Members find gyms, studios and workout spots near them, join fitness events and challenges, and monitor their progress. Gym owners get smart tools, analytics and AI innovation for their business.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://fitaval.com/): Overview, hero and app download badges
- [About](https://fitaval.com/#about): What Fitaval is and community stats (500+ members, 30+ weekly classes, 100+ certified trainers)
- [Features](https://fitaval.com/#features): Discover Clubs, Events & Challenges, Redefining Fitness Business, Grow Your Healthy Journey
- [Community](https://fitaval.com/#community): What members say about Fitaval
- [FAQ](https://fitaval.com/#faq): Common questions with short answers
- [Join Fitaval](https://fitaval.com/#join): Registration form for members, trainers and gym owners
